thesis: EXEL has run +32% in 63 days into an undated, potentially binary FDA decision on zanzalintinib, and it trades above the mean analyst target. The post-earnings high of 73.69 on 11/5 was reversed on heavy volume, and distribution days followed on 11/9 and 11/10. Short interest is about 14% of float, and Morningstar calls the stock overvalued. The tape is risk-off (QQQ below the 50- and 200-day averages, 10-year yield at the 91st percentile), so any FDA surprise or fade meets thin support. The entry zone sits only about 0.8 ATR above a stop at the gap low, so a routine pullback or gap can stop it out before the thesis plays out.
